title: ICONS
slide_intent: Use compact symbols for rapid orientation while keeping their scope distinct from other sign systems.
strategic_value: A clear functional icon vocabulary can support DB digital interfaces without conflating them with vehicle or architectural signage.
demonstration: The introduction explains the functional purpose of icons and identifies separate requirements for vehicles, architecture and wayfinding.
practical_value: Check that the intended use belongs to this functional icon system.

content_islands.name: Scope statement
content_islands.spec: Place the Icons heading above the purpose and application boundaries.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source links consistent icons to fast, intuitive orientation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: This system is exclusively functional, especially digital UI; vehicles, architecture and wayfinding have separate systems.
